card.name: Linking words before Confederacy or the South
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, the, and, into, for) and the start of 'Confederate' in American Civil War history text. They come just before a mention of the Confederacy or the South.

modes.label: Linking word before Confederacy
modes.description: A word like of, the, or for sits right before 'Confederacy' or 'Confederate' in Civil War prose.
modes.example: Despite recent reversals for<< the>> Confederacy, the war is still young

modes.label: Between Southern leaders
modes.description: A word like and or the sits in a list of Confederate figures such as Lee, Davis, or Stephens.

modes.label: Start of Confederate
modes.description: The first piece of the word Confederate, right after 'Southern'.
modes.example: equates to the “<<Conf>>ederate perspective of the war.”

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict Southern and Confederate words next.
card.plain: It fires in Civil War text when the next word is likely to be Confederate or Southern.
